opening.argument: The speaker describes receiving a $25 Lowe’s gift card through a text-message giveaway and using it for household shopping, reporting that checkout went well and the items were basically free. The promotion is presented as a coupon or gift-card offer, with viewers told to text a specified word, follow a link, and use the coupon that day. Those steps are described without any fee, credential request, or payment requirement. The account therefore supports an ordinary rewards or promotional demonstration; the available evidence does not establish a charge or other payment condition attached to obtaining the reward.
